title: Word Made Flesh
definition: The Word made flesh is the doctrine that the eternal Word, Jesus Christ, truly became human while remaining fully God.
summary: The eternal Word entered human life to reveal God and redeem sinners.
christFocus: Jesus is the Word made flesh, full of grace and truth, who makes the Father known.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
John calls Jesus the Word because He reveals God personally and perfectly. The Word was with God and was God, and this eternal Word became flesh.

The incarnation was not God pretending to be human. The Son truly took on human nature while remaining fully divine. In Him, God came near in grace and truth.

The Word made flesh is central to salvation. The One who reveals God also bears sin, conquers death, and brings people into fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often separate the God they cannot see from the Jesus who walked among us. This doctrine matters because in Jesus, God has come near and made Himself known.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Look to Jesus when you want to know what God is like. Receive Him as the Word made flesh and listen to His words as the words of God.
